subject.size_in_frame: whole body in frame, about 0.72 of frame height, head to shoe

headroom: about 0.12 of frame height above her crown and the same below her shoes — she is given a complete, unhurried box to be calm in.
horizon_eyeline: No horizon; the cupboard door rails travel up through the frame as a moving ladder of horizontals. Her eyeline is level at 0.36 of frame height, the lens height, and wanders about her as she looks around — never down.

layers.fg: the near cupboard door edge passing up through the right edge of frame
layers.mg: Alice upright and whole, posting the jar into a passing cupboard
layers.bg: the glazed cupboard wall travelling steadily upward, glass and mahogany, the open drop dark at the left edge

gaze.note: having tidied the jar away to her right, she turns her look out to frame left and the open shaft while she speaks — about 0.24 of frame width of clear space ahead of her. The lead room is the falling itself.

balance: Her whole figure just left of centre, the cupboard wall filling the right; the picture is weighted toward the furniture, which is exactly how she is treating it.
leading_lines: The horizontal shelf and rail lines cross the frame and travel up through it, so the only sense of motion is a ladder passing a stationary girl; her outstretched arm to the cupboard makes the one diagonal.
eye_first: Her whole upright body — the shape of a person standing still in mid-air — then the jar going into the cupboard.
constraint_binding: Her whole body in frame so the impossible calm reads: no crop of the figure at any point, top or bottom, and no move. The composure is the information, and it only exists if the entire silhouette is visible.
